scientific_integrity: Analytical proof for all allowed sizes; independent finite exact matrix checks through part sizes 5; no independent audit or physical experiment claimed.
scientific_limitations: The one-sided, not absolute, spectral gap of a uniformly chosen labeled-vertex local-complementation Markov chain on biclique graph-state representatives; m,n >= 2. Orbit structure up to permutation is prior work. Exact asymptotic total-variation mixing rate not asserted.
title: Exact spectral gap for random local complementation of biclique graph states
